hypothesis: Advancing vehicle speed differs from upstream spatial mean at recovery edges; a paired causal correction may improve discharge response.
formula: epsilon_i=beta*max(v[i+1]-v[i],0); dP=q_accepted[i]*dt_h*epsilon_i; P_i-=dP; P_i+1+=dP, applied to post-step stocks with a shared bounded dP.
fit: Exploratory current-state gradient regression on s29 NC moving-vehicle BEFORE speeds; other inspected states evaluated for explanatory error only.
selection: Require >=20% improvement in normalized paired gain/discharge/merge response loss, <=10% worsening of mean whole-road N/q RMSE; no further sweep if fail.
validation: s43 common2220 four arms and s29 common2670 hold/release with VSL90; no wrong meaningful signs and response improvements in both cases.
scope: East31 cells plus8connectors, not full Omega or9000 policy. Previously inspected data, not untouched holdout.
invariants: equal-opposite speed moment residual, not complete physical momentum model
actual accepted merge, ramp cost, off storage and all controls unchanged
apply donor reaction at23; do not call it cell24/25-only dynamics
loss: Mean over three command differences: (deltaTTT error/.5veh-h)^2 + (delta totalexit error/50veh)^2 + (delta merge error/50veh)^2
execution_note: One additional disabled rollout was needed to isolate tuple/list serialization mismatch. It was reused after JSON normalization; all saved physical arrays match exactly. Candidate budget unchanged.
